name: PNGS Gargi Fashion Jewellery L
summary: PNGS Gargi Fashion Jewellery Ltd. specializes in the production and distribution of a wide array of jewellery items. Their extensive range caters to diverse life events, from grand weddings and vibrant festivals to everyday adornment, thoughtfully designed for individuals of every age and gender. The company's offerings prominently feature distinct categories crafted from gold, diamonds, and rose gold. Established in 1832, the firm operates from its central hub in Pune, India.
